# Pixa

> > Pixa is an AI-powered creative platform offering text-to-image generation, photo editing, and image enhancement tools for designers, artists, and content creators.

Pixa provides a comprehensive suite of AI-driven tools including color editors, pose generators, 3D model creators, image upscalers, and specialized design generators. The platform supports various file formats (PNG, JPG, HEIC) and serves both professional creators and casual users looking to enhance their visual content with prompt-based editing and AI image enhancement.

## Key Topics

- Pixa AI Agent
- Text-to-image generation
- Prompt-based editing
- AI photo editor
- AI image enhancement
- Image recoloring and hue changing
- AI color editing
- Pose reference generation
- Character design and animation
- 3D model rendering
- Image upscaling and unblurring
- Pixel art tools
- AI-generated backgrounds and overlays
- Logo and font generation
- Product photography

## AI Photo Editing & Enhancement

- [Free Hue Changer | Edit Image Hues with AI](https://www.pixa.com/create/hue-changer): AI-powered tool to change image hues and colors using text prompts
- [Unblur Image Free Online: Fix Blurry Photos Using AI](https://www.pixa.com/image-upscaler/unblur-image): AI-powered image upscaler to unblur and sharpen photos online
- [Free Map Color Editor | Edit Map Colors with AI](https://www.pixa.com/create/map-color-editor): AI editor customizing map colors with text-based prompts
- [Free Falling Snow Overlay Generator | Add Snow to Photos with AI](https://www.pixa.com/create/falling-snow-overlay-generator): AI photo editor adding realistic falling snow effects to images
